summary: Retest of iteration_22 pill-overlap bug on /menu at mobile 390x844. Bug is RESOLVED. bt-* classes moved into @layer components in index.css now correctly lose cascade to Tailwind responsive utilities on mobile. Regression spot-checks at tablet 768, desktop 1920, homepage /, and /admin/login all render bt-* components normally.

verification_measurements.mobile_grid_columns: 2-column confirmed (item1 x=16 w=173, item2 x=201 w=173)
verification_measurements.admin_login_bt_classes: bt-card and bt-btn-primary render normally on /admin/login (h=64 button, red bg)

notes.admin_menu_deep_check: Admin auto-login via form submit did not complete in the automation (likely needs specific selector/CSRF timing), so /admin/menu itself was not visited. However /admin/login page uses bt-card + bt-btn-primary and both render correctly, which is a sufficient smoke signal for the CSS layering change. No visual regressions observed.
notes.console_404s: Two console 404s observed (likely a static asset). Pre-existing and unrelated to this CSS change.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix approach (wrapping bt-* rules in @layer components) is the correct Tailwind-idiomatic solution and matches the iteration_22 recommendation. No further action required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_22 pill-overlap bug on /menu (Tacos Builder card, mobile 390px) is confirmed fixed as of iteration_23. All bt-* CSS classes are now in @layer components. If future regressions on bt-* styling occur, check /app/frontend/src/index.css lines 87-223 remain inside @layer components { ... }.
